mission: Alliance intelligence briefing confirms Centerpoint Station reactivation; Cal Omas authorizes preliminary counter-operation planning.
why_now: Alliance intelligence has now corroborated the Corellian engineering effort.
opening_hook: Dr. Seyah projecting Centerpoint schematic over Cal Omas's desk.
conflict: Alliance desire to contain vs. the super-weapon threat's escalation logic.
turning_point: Cal Omas authorizes initial planning for a Centerpoint counter-operation.
closing_hook: Omas signing the authorization chip; the chip handed to Niathal.
setting: Cal Omas's private Senate office, Coruscant.
sensory_details: Schematic projection glow; Niathal's clawed grip on a stylus; Pellaeon's tea cup precisely half full.
canon_elements_needed: Cal Omas as Chief of State circa 40 ABY
Pellaeon and Niathal as joint chiefs
notes: Intelligence-register scene; the midpoint engine ignites here.
